## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.0-beta.9 keeps scoped graph lookups usable while background refresh and cleanup proceed, so agents can reuse compatible ready code evidence instead of repeating large-monorepo discovery.

Threadnote 5 helps agents begin with focused, cited code context. This beta makes that context more dependable when a project graph is being refreshed or background work is reclaiming resources.

### Reuse the project graph you already chose

Once Threadnote has resolved a project scope, agents can keep using that scope and its latest compatible ready graph while newer source evidence is prepared. Work continues from the useful graph snapshot already available, rather than rediscovering a large monorepo before every lookup.

When the updated graph is ready, Threadnote uses it for later work. A scope whose definition changed is never reused, so focused evidence remains tied to the project boundary you configured.
